acceptance.requirement: Every live path is assigned one primary class or an explicit binary/non-text disposition.
Every claim-family match records path, exact text or digest pointer, class, active/historical authority and required action.
Current-authority superseded claims equal zero before Route 01-1 PASS.

Old candidate/schema/validator/workflow/runtime are classified without executing or promoting them.
PR #8 and preview metadata are external stale non-authority, with no PR operation.
No runtime, asset, V1 executable, backend, provider or Production change occurs.
Exact content/evidence commit-tree-deployment records bind the completed inventory checkpoint.
